brief:
Palestinian Ambassador to the European Union Amal Jadou Shakaa met with the EU's Special Representative for the Middle East Peace Process Christophe Bigot to discuss recent political developments and the current situation, the Palestine News Network reported. The meeting reflected European diplomatic efforts to revive the two-state solution framework.

Details of the specific topics addressed and outcomes from the discussion were not disclosed in the initial report.

title: EU pushes revival of two-state solution with Palestinian envoy
